items.title: A projective cover, when it exists, is unique up to isomorphism
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dualizing.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a projective cover of a module, when it exists, is unique up to isomorphism (author lemma at source lines 638-642, label lemma-projective-cover-unique). The proof (source lines 644-653) compares two covers by a map over the module, shows it is surjective by essentialness, splits the source along it by projectivity and kills the kernel again by essentialness (proof lines 644-652). The splitting step is the substance. H3.
